messages:
alex chen: Heads up — I ran a quick pass on audit coverage and found gaps across gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Need triage + a plan for customer-facing validation. Who can take ownership?

maria g: can you list the concrete missing events? i remember billing had no invoice.download event last time we checked.

alex chen: quick list: API gateway missing request-id correlation on 4xx/5xx and upstream service mapping; auth missing role-change events for service accounts and token revocation provenance; console missing org-settings.change and admin-impersonation events; billing missing invoice.download and payment.method.change exposures; runtime missing model.start/model.stop, cache.eviction, and node-provenance. also schemas are inconsistent — some services use `user_id` while others use `actor.id`.

jeff park: We should standardize on schema v2: actor.{id,type}, target.{id,type}, event.{action,category}, metadata. I'll open an RFC + example schema PR. Also KMS note: never log key material — only reference key_id.

jeff park: example schema snippet:
```json
{
  "event": {"action":"role.change","category":"auth"},
  "actor": {"id":"u_123","type":"user"},
  "target": {"id":"svc_abc","type":"service_account"},
  "metadata": {"prior_roles":["viewer"],"new_roles":["operator"]},
  "timestamp":"2026-11-03T15:22:30Z"
}
```

sam patel: +1 to schema v2. For RBAC changes include `prior_roles` and `new_roles` arrays and an optional `change_reason`. Also use ISO8601 timestamps and add `sequence_number` for tamper-evidence.

leah o'connor: For customer validation, propose a public sample-event endpoint in the console that returns sanitized examples per event type, plus a downloadable schema catalog. That helps customers map their SIEMs.

alex chen: Action items: jeff = open RFC + PR for schema v2 and migration plan; sam = prototype producer changes for gateway & auth (include sequence numbers); maria = own billing & console event additions; leah = customer examples and console catalog; i'll schedule triage session tomorrow 10:30am PT. audit-bot, please create backlog ticket. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Created issue INFR-2027: "Audit event provenance and coverage gaps" assigned to @alex chen, labels: security,audit,backlog.

maria g: runtime team notes — model.start/stop should include model_version, node_id, quantization_profile, and approximate memory_freed for cache.eviction events. we'll need to coordinate telemetry schema with runtime infra.

jeff park: migration strategy idea: accept v1 + v2 for a 3-month window with deprecation warnings in logs. also evaluate event-level signatures (HMAC) for cross-service validation — would give consumers proof of origin.

sam patel: HMAC useful but adds key-rotation complexity. alternative: sign bundles when uploading to long-term storage using KMS; services can include `bundle_digest` and `signed_by_kms` metadata.

leah o'connor: For the customer-facing "proof", include `validation_status` and a `proof` field (signed digest or a KMS-backed attest). We should avoid exposing internal key_ids publicly; use symptom-free references.

alex chen: timeline proposal: RFC this week, prototypes by EOD Fri, demo next Wed. triage meeting Tue 10:30 PT. if any owner can't meet their task, flag now.

maria g: FYI — billing SME on PTO Thu-Fri; i'll try to cover but may need help finishing the invoice.download work.

audit-bot: Reminder: triage meeting Tue 10:30 PT — https://meet.redwood.ai/abc123

jeff park: One more operational note: ensure logs forwarded to external customers are redacted and accompanied by a schema version header so their parsers can handle both versions during the migration window.

alex chen: thanks all. i'll drop an RFC link here once jeff opens it and create the calendar invite.

maria g: thanks — i'll prep a short checklist for the console/billing changes before the triage.

sam patel: will prototype sequence_number + minimal HMAC wrapper for bundle signing by EOD Fri.

leah o'connor: i'll design the catalog page and the sample-event API, will share a mock before the meeting.

alex chen: perfect. closing thread for now — see you at triage.
